verdicts.decision_note: The client requests four additional voice-over takes and identifies Take Seven as the comparison baseline for the task-local audio deliverable.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports recording and delivering seven raw takes for comparison.
The client changes the selected comparison preference from Take Seven to Take Four; the pacing feedback is correctly excluded from this Requirement.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports delivering eight additional takes after the client's revised selection and feedback.
First concrete verification after the additional delivery: the client reports hearing four distinct voice-over directions and positively evaluates Takes Six and Eight.
The client establishes a four-take shortlist and identifies Takes Six and Eight as leading options, replacing the obsolete singular preferred-take selection used for the prior batch.
